# 最小组合事务探针，全部入口只供独立测试人物使用，不是正式年度业务。
# 人物作用域；SOURCE/TARGET由调用者冻结的核定等级提供，BASE为目标最低经验/余额。
# 前置：已有核定动态上限两修正、及第副本，且未参与其他保护窗口；不读取同链等级作业务判断。
# phase：1核准队列、2已提交待跨日校验、3资格失效取消、4不升品；任何已有phase均拒绝重入。
# 持久保存来源、目标、基准、最高领主和phase；核准期间不改上限/双账、不设置回调保护。
tca_test_begin_merit_transaction_probe_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tca_mtx_phase } }
        set_variable = { name = tca_mtx_source value = $SOURCE$ }
        set_variable = { name = tca_mtx_target value = $TARGET$ }
        set_variable = { name = tca_mtx_base value = $BASE$ }
        set_variable = { name = tca_mtx_liege value = top_liege }
        set_variable = { name = tca_merit_reset_probe_gain_count value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = tca_merit_reset_probe_loss_count value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = tca_merit_reset_probe_marked_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:tca_mtx_target > var:tca_mtx_source }
            set_variable = { name = tca_mtx_phase value = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = tca_mtx_phase value = 4 } }
    }
}

# 人物作用域，无参数；核准队列可跨日/保存重载，提交起点重新复核资格。
# 提交为不可撤销的同链边界：短保护归一化→刷新目标cap→保护set目标→余额基准→解除保护。
# 不手动补发合法回调；随后cap的异步刷新产生恰一次原生gain，调用方至少跨日再验。
# 显式补发或解除保护后set目标均与异步gain叠加为双发；独立负对照保留这个限制。
# phase2拒绝任何重入，不重新归一化；失效时不碰双账或上限，也无待撤销的cap变化。
tca_test_commit_merit_transaction_probe_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:tca_mtx_phase = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes has_government = celestial_government top_liege = var:tca_mtx_liege }
            add_character_flag = tca_merit_reset_probe_suppress
            set_merit_level = 0
            set_merit_level = var:tca_mtx_source
            set_variable = { name = tca_merit_probe_approved value = var:tca_mtx_target }
            remove_character_modifier = tca_merit_probe_approved_reduction_modifier
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = tca_merit_probe_approved_reduction_modifier }
            set_merit_level = var:tca_mtx_target
            change_merit_no_experience = { value = var:tca_mtx_base subtract = merit }
            remove_character_flag = tca_merit_reset_probe_suppress
            set_variable = { name = tca_mtx_phase value = 2 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = tca_mtx_phase value = 3 }
        }
    }
}

# 人物作用域；清理事务持久字段与观测变量，不清理共享人物夹具，允许调用者随后断言清理。
tca_test_cleanup_merit_transaction_probe_effect = {
    remove_character_flag = tca_merit_reset_probe_suppress
    remove_variable = tca_mtx_source
    remove_variable = tca_mtx_target
    remove_variable = tca_mtx_base
    remove_variable = tca_mtx_liege
    remove_variable = tca_mtx_phase
    remove_variable = tca_merit_reset_probe_gain_count
    remove_variable = tca_merit_reset_probe_loss_count
    remove_variable = tca_merit_reset_probe_marked_count
}
